text:
elena: quick FYI saw a regression on deid-longform after q5b-int4 rollout. Hallu rate up on long summaries and tabular-lists. Need a focused microgolden and a kernel/quant sweep.

juan: can you paste the short eval?

elena: small paste:
```
$ rbin eval --model q5b-2.0-int4 --dataset deid-longform-v3 --slices long_summaries,table_lists
Hallucination-rate: 8.2% (+2.9% vs fp16)
High-severity: 3.1% (+1.8%)
ROUGE-L: 36.0
```

priya: thanks. does kv-cache toggling change it? any obvious kernel differences?

elena: quick ablate: kv-cache off -> hallu -0.3%. So small. Looks numeric/attention quant paths.

nora: I'll run a kernel + permute sweep today. Example command: 
```
rbin quant-sweep --model q5b-2.0 --bits 4 --kernels aten,flash --permute none,block --kv-cache on,off --eval deid-longform-v3 --out logs/q5b-int4-sweep
```

juan: on dataset side propose microgolden: 250 longform (>=800 tokens) sampled from last 30 days RAG (deid-filtered), 60 table-list edgecases, and 60 synthetic paraphrases focused on entity shifts. 3 labelers per item.

elena: dedupe plan: sample 1k -> fuzzy-shingle 3-gram dedupe -> fingerprint -> surface 450 -> label queue -> finalize 250. include provenance fields: source_ts, session_id, md5_text, shingle_hash.

labeler-bot: Labeling batch LB-9991 created for ticket ML-4317. ETA first pass 48 hrs.

priya: labeler checklist (ops copy):
1) confirm source content present and PII masked
2) mark any invented content as 'hallucination' with smallest evidence span
3) severity 0-3

elena: console: add a small card tracking 'longform-hallu-rate' on golden vs prod slices; alert if +2% week-over-week.

nora: will attach sweep logs to ML-4317. If a kernel variant fixes it we can pin or add per-model kernel overrides. If not, try per-layer fp16 exceptions for attn/layernorm.

juan: I'll start assembly + dedupe and push artifacts to ML-4317/artifacts. Ping when LB-9991 is populated.

elena: action items: (1) nora run sweep + logs to ML-4317, (2) juan assemble + dedupe + make LB-9991, (3) labelers start LB-9991, (4) priya open console card. Ping me for blockers. :thumbsup:
